found_values.value: at least 2,000 samples per second on the vibration channel. The balance screen takes rotors of 2 to 6 blades. At 10,000 rpm (V196) a 6-blade rotor's blade-pass frequency is 6 x 166.7 Hz = 1,000 Hz. Sampled at 2,000 S/s or more, it does not fold onto the 167 Hz fundamental. The fundamental alone needs more than 2 x 166.7 = 333 S/s. The seed ADXL1002's 3 dB bandwidth is 11 kHz, so content between 1,000 Hz and 11 kHz still folds into the band at 2,000 S/s unless the front end filters it (round 2). Derived from the blade count, V196 and the sampling theorem; no source states a rate

found_values.value: 0.33 V to 2.97 V. This is the output of the seed analogue accelerometer, the ADXL1002, on a 3.3 V supply across its +/-50 g range. Its 0 g output is VDD/2, 1.65 V. Its sensitivity is ratiometric to VDD: 40 mV/g at 5.0 V, so 26.4 mV/g at 3.3 V, and +/-1.32 V at 50 g. The figure holds for that sensor at 3.3 V; R11 selects the sensor in the same task. On the RP2354B's ADC the input also stays at or below IOVDD, 3.201 V at the 3.3 V rail's -3 % (section 12.4; Research.md:283)

dropped.reason: Misses the sample rate: 8 to 860 SPS (SBAS444E page 1, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads1115.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:10:00Z), under the 2,000 S/s of V197. Seed

Misses the input span. The differential input range is -VREF/gain to +VREF/gain, and the internal reference is 1.2 V, so the range is +/-1.2 V at gain 1 (SBAS853A Recommended Operating Conditions, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads131m02.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:09:59Z). The 0.33 to 2.97 V of V200 is a +/-1.32 V swing about mid-supply, so it clips above +/-45 g without a divider in front (round 2). With a divider it would fit, and its external CLKIN (0.3 to 8.4 MHz) could come from the coprocessor and put its conversions on the coprocessor's timebase. P3 may re-read this drop

Seed. Not qualified: its data sheet SBAS890D was not re-read in this task. The ADS131M02 of the same family misses the input span for the same reason (+/-1.2 V at gain 1), and the M04's extra channels are not needed for 1 axis (V201)

Seed. Not shortlisted (five survivors at most). Conversions are started by commands on I2C, which on the coprocessor's shared sensor bus follow that bus's traffic. Its internal oscillator is +/-4 % in turbo mode. Ranked below the SAR parts that start on a CS edge

report.figure: Q4 alternatives: RP2354B resources for P5
report.value: Reference option: 1 of the 8 ADC inputs (GPIO40 to 47); the ADC FIFO streams through 1 DMA channel on DREQ_ADC; ADC_AVDD from the reference. The input stays at or below IOVDD, and the pad input enable is cleared on the ADC pin (section 12.4). External ADC option (ADCS7476 or ADS7042): 3 bank 0 GPIO for CS, SCLK and data out, on an SPI controller or a PIO state machine; the RP2354B ADC is not used. How samples are moved (DMA or interrupt) is not fixed here
